trailhead.label: Plan de la Lai refuge on the Cormet de Roselend road, the board’s start

cautions: Working alpages: cows graze along the road and path in summer and guard dogs may be present; keep your dog on a lead and walk round the herds.
High, open ground at 1,800–2,070 m: no shade and quick weather changes.
The alpage road is used by farm vehicles: lead on.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
